_comment: Duplicated verbatim in org.eclipse.fennec.mcp.emf.runtime.config and org.eclipse.fennec.mcp.inference.config so each runtime is self-contained. EMFModelGuard and EMFPackageRegistry are SINGLETON PIDs: if both bundles are ever deployed in one framework the Configurator applies one of them wholesale and discards the other - it does not merge. Keep the two copies identical, or the effective allow-list depends on which bundle wins.
